assumptions: One stale key and at most three sequential background loaders; delivery expiry, loader completion, cache publication and ownership release are separate events.
A delivery timeout cannot cancel the loader. Permanently hung uncancellable work retains its key and consumes one queue slot; no eventual recovery or provider-success guarantee is claimed.
Cold misses and cache-read failures join a retained background result. Cold-only loads keep their existing non-coalesced policy and are outside the finite single-owner property.
Loaders must not recursively await a cold read of the same owned key. In-tree SWR callers delegate to leaf database queries or provider catalog reads.

Cache writes succeed atomically in the model; real local Redis regression separately delays a write. Cross-process ownership, invalidation races, backend outages and elapsed wall time remain unproved.

The default conformance hook uses real HTTP and the production MemoryCacheAdapter with a 100 ms test deadline. Optional CACHE_SWR_TEST_REDIS_BINARY and CACHE_SWR_TEST_REAL_DEADLINE=1 run local Redis and the production 30 second timeout.
bounds.progress: Safety only; no scheduler or provider liveness claim.
